english.note: Use this for a particular time when something happened or a particular instance, as in 今次 or 嗰次.
Use this for one occurrence or instance, as in 一次 or 再一次, rather than for duration.

examples.english: I was really scared on that occasion.
examples.jyutping: go2 ci3 ngo5 zan1 hai6 haak3 can1

examples.english: The first time I went to Japan, I joined a tour.
examples.traditional: 我第一次去日本係跟團。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 dai6 jat1 ci3 heoi3 jat6 bun2 hai6 gan1 tyun4
